chunks: And with this chain, from al-Hasan, from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-'Ala', from Abi Basir, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Whoever recites 'Wailul lilla humazah' (Surah Al-Humazah) in his obligatory prayers, Allah will remove poverty from him, bring him sustenance, and protect him from a bad death.
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual and material benefits of reciting Surah Al-Humazah in obligatory prayers?
ai.summary: Shaykhulafa al-Saduq records that reciting Surah Al-Humazah during obligatory prayers (fara'id) serves as a spiritual remedy for the traits of the 'humazah' (slanderer), specifically warding off poverty, attracting sustenance, and protecting from a bad death. This practice highlights the Shia emphasis on the transformative power of Quranic recitation in aligning the believer's character with divine attributes and securing worldly and otherworldly well-being.
